title: Support Chatbot: Live Account Data, Confidence Gate, Human Handoff

sections.label: 1 · CUSTOMER MESSAGE COMES IN
sections.note: Every message is tied to a session and a customer id before the model sees it, so the agent never guesses whose account it is looking at.

sections.label: 2 · THE SUPPORT AGENT ANSWERS WITH LIVE ACCOUNT DATA
sections.note: One agent, a locked system prompt, and three tools that call your backend API. It reads real account, order and billing data instead of making it up.

sections.label: 3 · SEND IT, RETRY IT, OR HAND IT TO A HUMAN
sections.note: The reply only goes out when the model reports high confidence and no sensitive action. Backend errors retry once, everything else goes to a person with full context.

sections.label: 4 · LOG EVERY TURN, FAIL LOUDLY
sections.note: Each turn is logged with tokens and outcome so prompt changes can be measured. Any node failure alerts a human with a link to the run.

nodes.label: Backend API: Order and Billing Status
7 · Pause 2 Seconds and Retry the Call
8 · Escalate to a Human With Context
11 · Alert With a Link to the Failed Run

input_sample.chatInput: Hi, I was charged twice this month and my last order still says processing. Can you check what's going on? My account email is dana.whitfield@example.com

tools_called: Backend API: Fetch Account Details (200, 142 ms)
Backend API: Order and Billing Status (200, 218 ms)
output_sample.answer: Hi Dana, I checked your account. The second charge on Sep 3 for $49.00 is a pending authorization from a failed retry, not a real charge, and it will drop off within 3 to 5 business days. Your order #A-88213 is in processing because the warehouse is waiting on one item, expected to ship Sep 9. Want me to send you a note the moment it ships?
output_sample.if_it_had_failed: Confidence under 0.75 or any refund or cancel request goes to Slack with the full transcript and account snapshot; a backend error retries once, then escalates.
